item.title: Inner Body Guided-Meditation (20 minutes) — Thu Aug 6, 6:30 PM
item.description:
The Mindful Stream (CA) "Awareness of the inner body takes you beyond the mind." - Eckhart Tolle
In this mediation session we will bring our attention here: to the inner body. Sessions are suitable for newcomers, those experienced in Tolle's teachings and anyone wishing to remain completely anonymous. They will last around 20 minutes and cameras and microphones will be disabled. (Depending on the situation, a free discussion may be held at the end with mics and cameras allowed.)
See you there!
Emrys also organises a free Work of Byron Katie online mediation group. Visit [this Meetup Group link](https://www.meetup.com/thework-runsfree/) for more information.
Please be aware that sessions will close if no members have joined after 10 minutes.
Source: Meetup: Mindful Petaluma

item.title: Merging Music & Humanity — Sun Aug 9, 7:00 PM — Polly Klaas Community Theater
item.description: Turn your Sunday into a night to remember! Join us on August 9th at 7 PM for an unforgettable evening of music with one of New Orleans’ most distinctive pianists—Tom McDermott. Proceeds from this concert will directly help Global Healing’s ongoing efforts in Roatán, Honduras, continuing to support fire recovery and providing the assistance needed to facilitate the hospital’s services. In 2024, a shocking fire ravaged the sole public hospital on Roatán. Home to Global Healing’s pediatric clinic for over the past two decades, the hospital was vital for emergency care for both children and adults, performing urgent surgeries, and providing maternity services—like life-saving C-sections. Reduced to ashes, the hospital and clinic left Honduras with even fewer means to deliver essential medical care. All medical equipment was lost, and recovery is still ongoing. item.title: West Side Stories Petaluma — Wed Aug 12, 7:00 PM — Polly Klaas Community Theater
item.description:
Everyone has a story and now it’s your chance to tell it. Every month there is a theme, hopefully that sparks a memory for you. You put your name in a hat (an actual hat!) and 10 people’s names are drawn at random. When your name is pulled you get 5 minutes to tell your personal true story. At the end of the evening everyone votes by text for their favorite story of the night. If that’s you, you get $50 and will join the other monthly winners in December for our GrandSlam at the Historic Mystic Theater. Sounds like fun, rightYou should purchase tickets in advance to secure your seat, so click on the box above to get yours. Show time is always 7:30 pm and because we normally sell out in advance there is a “stand-by line” for any last minute tickets — Buy Tickets here
Source: Polly Klaas Community Theater

item.title: Wednesday Night Walk: Petaluma Downtown & Riverfront — Wed Aug 26, 6:00 PM
item.description:
"SONOMA COUNTY OUTDOORS" Wednesday Night Walk: Petaluma Downtown and Riverfront
* Want to walk for fitness and exercise? * New to walking and want to build up stamina? * Like a slower pace than our Tuesday Night Fitness Hike? * Would walking with a committed group of walkers help you?
If you said yes to any of these, then the Wednesday Night Walk in Petaluma is for you. We start at Aqus Cafe and take in the West Side of town, including some of Downtown, the Waterfront and a few of the Historic home of old Petaluma. We walk about 3-1/2 to 4-1/2 miles depending on weather conditions and the pace of the group that night.
Afterward if you have the time, join us at Aqus Cafe for a bite to eat and some liquid refreshment before heading home. Aqus Cafe is a true gem of a gathering place, restaurant, coffee house, and live music venue. But it's the people on either side of the counter that make this place so special.
DETAILS:
* Meetup time: 6:00pm (we hike at 6:10 sharp) * Meetup location

item.title: Mindfulness Sunday Meditation: Cultivating Consciousness — Sun Aug 9, 9:00 AM
item.description: Meditate with a Monk in Sonoma County Join us for a transformative workshop on mindfulness meditation and cultivating consciousness. Dive deep into the teachings of Theravada Buddhism, focusing on insight meditation to develop a clear understanding of the nature of the mind and consciousness. This workshop will include guided meditation sessions to help you strengthen your meditation practice and cultivate mindfulness in your daily life. Whether you are a beginner or an experienced meditator, this workshop offers a welcoming space to explore the depths of your own consciousness and enhance your spiritual journey. Come together with like-minded individuals to deepen your practice and connect with the wisdom of Theravada Buddhism, and provide an opportunity to deepen mindfulness, wisdom, and inner stillness. Our sessions are led by Bhikkhunis closely associated with our Dhammadharini Sangha. Check out the [recording from the past event](https://youtube.com/live/s07U2kzWoWk?feature=share)

item.title: Curanderismo en Nuestras Vidas — Fri Sep 11, 6:00 PM — SRJC Roseland
item.description:
Conferencia gratis: Acompáñenos a estar en comunidad y aprender con yerberas, hueseras, y otras personas con conocimiento ancestral. Los talleres se enfocarán en como recuperar conocimientos ancestrales de como las hierbas, plantas, nuestros ancestros, y nuestra comunidad pueden ayudarnos a sanar físicamente y emocionalmente. Este evento es para tode aquelles interesades en conectarse más con el curanderismo, sea usted principiante o con décadas de conocimiento. Todas edades bienvenidas. Evento en español. La conferencia está abierta al público en general del condado de Sonoma y sus alrededores. Tenemos 100 espacios. Más información aquí (https://intercultural.santarosa.edu/events)
Source: Santa Rosa Junior College

item.title: "Paddle The Petaluma: Turn to The River" Guided Kayak Tour — Sun Oct 18, 10:00 AM — The Floathouse Petaluma
item.description:
Paddle the Petaluma: Turn to The River is a relaxed, beginner-friendly guided kayak tour exploring the past, present, and future of Petaluma’s historic waterway. Launching right from downtown at The Floathouse Petaluma https://www.thefloathousepetaluma.org?utm_source=chatgpt.com , this Sonoma County Signature Experience spends about 90 minutes on the water in stable sit-on-top kayaks, traveling a gentle mile-and-a-half route through “Petaluma’s Longest Park.”
Along the way, you’ll raft up at docks around town, fascinating landmarks, and riverfront gathering spaces to hear stories about how this Gold Rush-era “saltwater highway” helped shape Petaluma—and how today’s community is continuing to reinvent and reconnect with the river. This isn’t just a history tour. You’ll also learn about the people, businesses, artists, nonprofits, and river advocates helping shape the waterway’s future right now.

item.title: Awaken Yoga @ Keller Street Cowork — Sat Aug 8, 9:00 AM
item.description:
Nourish 108 Ayurveda & Yoga Join me for 60 minutes of nourishing morning yoga in the beautiful open space at Keller Street Cowork. While I am here to offer a sequence of poses, this practice is yours to give your mind and body what it needs. Please bring your own yoga mat and any props you may need (strap, block, bolster, blanket) and arrive a few minutes early to get situated. I have extra mats if you need.
All levels welcome!

item.description:
"This showing is a perspective on the retrospective; sort of." Jonny Hirschmugl is a painter, builder, and a main character in this satire of life. In all his creative endeavors, his main qualities are ever present: nostalgic, romantic, & delusional. A Petaluma native, his art is influenced by the riverscape story of this town. Buried in the iron facades of downtown's structures, to the labyrinth sewers below. And the heritage farmlands, with forgotten tales, that only the ravens can recite so well. Jonny has exhibited his paintings in gallery shows and various markets for the last 17 years. His murals can be seen throughout Petaluma, and spanning to nearby places in Sonoma County.

item.description:
The Mindful Stream (CA) In these sessions, I will be doing guided meditations where we simply sit and notice what arises.
There is no agenda and no plan for how these sessions unfold. I might start off simply by asking us to notice what is already present. By becoming aware of what’s going on in our heads and in our body.
Then, the meditation may take on a life of its own.
Our job is to simply be present to what arises. We may notice the mind moving and chattering about. Or we may notice that it’s completely silent.
The goal here, if there is one, is to simply let ourselves be as we are.
